data.description:
Placeholder for the generation-time prevention pillar of the test creation calibration North Star (was 643f-7f3a). 

Goal: change-detector-style tests (source-grep assertions, internal-method assertions, snapshot-on-implementation) are rejected at the point of generation — by the test-writing agent prompt, by a pre-commit reject gate, or both — rather than detected post-hoc.

Builds on plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md.

Out of scope: post-hoc detection of phantom test→source mappings (c13f-6196); suite growth vs behavioral coverage metrics (sibling epic); feedback loop from production bugs/review findings into test-creation prompts (sibling epic).

Refine via /dso:brainstorm.
data.title: Test creation calibration (a): generation-time prevention of change-detector tests
